date an AUSI inspected part was installed

ambiguities.description: The definition of a part eligible for installation names an "HPT 1st-stage disk or HPT 2nd-stage disk", while paragraphs (c) to (g) say "hub". The same P/Ns are meant, but the text does not say so.
readings: Hub and disk are the same parts (P/N 2A5001, 2A4802).
The definition covers different parts, leaving hub eligibility undefined.

ambiguities.description: "With no angled ultrasonic inspection (AUSI) performed" does not say whether an AUSI done before the effective date, or under other instructions, counts.
readings: Any earlier AUSI counts and (g)(1) does not apply; (g)(2) or (g)(4) does.
Only an AUSI per the listed service information counts.

ambiguities.description: "AUSI inspected parts installed on or after November 1, 2023" does not say whether the hub must also be listed in the service bulletin tables.
readings: Any hub that has had an AUSI.

notes: Every hub S/N list is in IAE AG NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0720 or PW SI No. 189F-23, incorporated by reference and not available, so an engine with P/N 2A5001 or 2A4802 installed goes to review naming the table.
Table 1 and table 2 limits depend on whether the hub has operated in a high-thrust model engine ((h)(3)), which no engine record field holds; each row is a separate action with that condition.
